parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood. It provides the overall shape and support for other components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the door, drawer, and base, maintaining the cabinet’s rigidity and alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds all other parts in place.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing stability and support.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and its contents, distributing load evenly to the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a solid wood panel attached to the frame with hinges, allowing access to the storage space inside.
parts.Functional_description: It opens and closes to provide access to the cabinet’s interior, protecting stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding compartment made of solid wood, located at the top of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a small, easily accessible storage space for utensils or small items.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along rails for access.
